name: NBHD Document Information-Keeping
description: Record provenance for information saved from an uploaded document, list past ingestions, and forget everything from one document via a single server-side fan-out.

apiBaseUrl.description: Override NBHD API base URL. Defaults to NBHD_API_BASE_URL env var.

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for NBHD runtime endpoint requests.

documentIngestionEnabled.description: Register the record/list/forget tools. config_generator injects this true whenever it loads the plugin (tenant.document_ingestion_enabled). Fail-closed: anything but true → no tools registered.
